title: Excel capability distillation for Folio Office
scope: Expanded Home ribbon plus broader spreadsheet capability inventory. Not an exhaustive inventory of every Excel build, add-in, function signature or hidden menu.

evidence_policy.visible: The control is visible in the supplied screenshot.
evidence_policy.visible_with_documented_expansion: The group/control is visible; variants are expanded from official references or prior local inspection.
evidence_policy.broader_suite_inventory: A product capability family outside the open Home ribbon. Tab presence is visible, some families have prior local inspection, and finer variants are proposed requirements pending version-specific acceptance.

agent_contract_status: All family names below are proposed design vocabulary, not claims of installed MCP tools. Current source separately defines spreadsheet.read, spreadsheet.write and spreadsheet.format.

screenshot.title: User-supplied Excel Home ribbon screenshot
screenshot.scope: Visible controls only; closed menus and other tab contents are not visible.

local.title: Previously inspected local Excel 16.0.20326.20132 Home, Insert and Data ribbons
local.scope: Observed command labels; not exhaustive behavior tests.

find.title: Microsoft: Find and select cells by conditions

navigation.title: Microsoft: Explore Excel with a screen reader

features.name: Quick access
features.variants: Save, undo, redo, customize frequently used commands

features.name: Ribbon navigation
features.variants: File, Home, Insert, Draw, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View, Help

features.name: Command search
features.variants: Find a command by intent or name and invoke it with explicit arguments

features.name: Name box
features.variants: Read the active address, jump to a cell or range, select a named range

features.name: Formula bar
features.variants: Inspect raw content, edit formula/value, confirm, cancel, insert a function

features.name: Grid navigation
features.variants: Cell, range, row, column, whole-sheet and disjoint selection; keyboard extension

features.name: Workbook identity
features.variants: Title, file name, dirty/saved/conflict state and current workspace

features.name: Window controls
features.variants: Minimize, maximize, restore, close and ribbon visibility

features.name: Sharing entry point
features.variants: Inspect sharing options; online delivery is an optional integration

features.name: Add-ins entry point
features.variants: Discover installed extensions and their declared capabilities

groups.acceptance: Keyboard focus remains visible; editing Escape restores the previous value; close waits for a save or exposes recovery. Shared commands never require an agent to click a ribbon.

features.name: Cut and copy
features.variants: Move or duplicate a cell range

features.name: Paste
features.variants: Apply selected source content to an explicit destination

features.name: Paste values or formulas
features.variants: Choose computed values versus formula expressions

features.name: Paste formats
features.variants: Apply cell appearance separately from content

features.name: Other paste modes
features.variants: Number formats, validation, comments/notes, widths and transposition where supported

features.name: Paste Special arithmetic
features.variants: Add, subtract, multiply or divide destination values by source values

features.name: Blank handling and links
features.variants: Skip source blanks; explicit linked paste rather than accidental external dependencies

features.name: Format Painter
features.variants: Reuse appearance on a different selection

groups.acceptance: Copy B2 formula =A2*$F$1 down one row and obtain =A3*$F$1. Paste-values freezes the result. A multi-cell operation is atomic and undoable; overlapping moves cannot erase source data before it is read.

features.name: Typeface and size
features.variants: Font family, size, increase/decrease

features.name: Emphasis
features.variants: Bold, italic, underline and its variants

features.name: Font effects
features.variants: Strike, superscript and subscript via detailed formatting

features.name: Foreground and fill
features.variants: Text and background colors, automatic/theme/custom colors

features.name: Border formatting
features.variants: Selected sides, inside/outside, style, weight and color

features.name: Detailed cell formatting
features.variants: Inspect and modify compatible properties in a single dialog

groups.acceptance: Range formatting changes only specified properties, retains formulas and exports/reimports supported appearance. Mixed selections show mixed state. Font availability is reported when an offline machine lacks a requested typeface.

features.name: Horizontal alignment
features.variants: Left, center and right; additional alignment modes in detailed settings

features.name: Vertical alignment
features.variants: Top, middle and bottom

features.name: Text orientation
features.variants: Rotate or orient content vertically

features.name: Indentation
features.variants: Increase/decrease text indentation

features.name: Wrap
features.variants: Wrap text within the cell width

features.name: Shrink to fit
features.variants: Fit display text without changing its stored content

features.name: Merge variants
features.variants: Merge-and-center, merge across, merge cells, unmerge

features.name: Reading direction
features.variants: Support left-to-right and right-to-left content

groups.acceptance: Merging a range containing several values first exposes the loss and a recoverable choice. Unmerge restores cell geometry. Wrapped row heights and rotation survive XLSX conversion where supported.

features.name: General and numeric
features.variants: General display, decimal precision, grouping and negative-number styles

features.name: Currency and accounting
features.variants: Currency symbols; accounting alignment of amounts

features.name: Percentages
features.variants: Percentage presentation with configurable precision

features.name: Dates and times
features.variants: Short/long dates, time-of-day and elapsed-time formats

features.name: Fraction and scientific
features.variants: Fractional and exponential display

features.name: Text and special formats
features.variants: Preserve identifiers and locale-specific patterns

features.name: Decimal controls
features.variants: Increase or decrease displayed decimal places

features.name: Custom formats
features.variants: Positive/negative/zero/text sections, literals, conditions and colors

groups.acceptance: A stored 0.125 becomes 12.5% without changing the value. Leading-zero identifiers remain text. Display precision cannot silently round saved calculations. Date interpretation and locale must be explicit.

features.name: Value and text rules
features.variants: Comparison, text matching and date-based conditions

features.name: Ranking rules
features.variants: Top/bottom, above/below average and duplicates/uniques

features.name: Visual indicators
features.variants: Data bars, color scales and icon sets

features.name: Formula rules
features.variants: Evaluate a condition relative to each target cell

features.name: Rule management
features.variants: Create, inspect, edit, order, clear and scope rules

features.name: Conflicts and priority
features.variants: Resolve overlapping rules predictably and expose supported stop behavior

groups.acceptance: Changing an input recalculates the relevant visual rule. The saved rule is readable by agents and survives reopening; colors alone are not the only accessible explanation.

features.name: Create table
features.variants: Explicit range, table name and header interpretation

features.name: Table presentation
features.variants: Banded rows/columns, header and totals presentation

features.name: Structured references
features.variants: Use persistent table and column names in formulas

features.name: Calculated columns
features.variants: Apply a column calculation as the table grows

features.name: Table operations
features.variants: Resize, rename and convert to a plain range

features.name: Reusable styles
features.variants: Apply named styles; inspect, create and modify style definitions

groups.acceptance: Adding a record extends the table and its column formulas. Renaming a column updates valid references. A table is stored as a semantic object, not inferred from colored cells.

features.name: Insert cells
features.variants: Shift neighboring cells right or down

features.name: Delete cells
features.variants: Shift remaining cells left or up

features.name: Row operations
features.variants: Insert/delete selected rows and preserve record alignment

features.name: Column operations
features.variants: Insert/delete selected columns

features.name: Dimensions
features.variants: Set row height and column width; autofit

features.name: Visibility
features.variants: Hide/unhide rows, columns and worksheets

features.name: Sheet creation and deletion
features.variants: Add, duplicate and remove sheets with recovery

features.name: Sheet organization
features.variants: Rename, reorder, move/copy sheets and set tab colors

features.name: Cell protection attributes
features.variants: Set locked/hidden attributes independently of workbook encryption

features.name: Sheet protection
features.variants: Enforce configured restrictions in both UI and agent operations

groups.acceptance: Inserting a row updates dependent references, tables, styles and ranges together. Deleting a referenced cell yields an explicit error or documented transformation. Undo restores structure as well as values.

features.name: AutoSum family
features.variants: Sum, average, count numbers, minimum and maximum; open further function selection

features.name: Directional fill
features.variants: Fill down, right, up or left

features.name: Series fill
features.variants: Numbers, dates and explicit steps/stops

features.name: Pattern fill
features.variants: Infer a pattern with a preview and a way to reject it

features.name: Clear contents
features.variants: Remove values/formulas while retaining other cell properties

features.name: Selective clearing
features.variants: Clear formats, comments/notes, hyperlinks or all selected content

features.name: Undo and redo
features.variants: Restore a complete logical operation

groups.acceptance: Fill distinguishes relative, absolute and mixed references. AutoSum identifies or accepts the intended range and refuses a silent overwrite. Clear-contents leaves formatting intact; Clear-all is a separate operation.

features.name: Simple sorting
features.variants: Ascending/descending text, numeric or date ordering

features.name: Custom sorting
features.variants: Multiple keys, headers, custom order, colors/icons when supported

features.name: Filtering
features.variants: Value lists, text/number/date conditions and blanks

features.name: Filter management
features.variants: Clear, reapply and inspect active criteria

features.name: Selection scope
features.variants: Distinguish visible records from all records

groups.acceptance: Sort keeps complete records together and shows the actual affected range. Filter state is inspectable and does not delete data. Hidden-row copy, fill and summary semantics are explicit.

features.name: Find
features.variants: Search within selection, sheet or workbook with explicit match settings

features.name: Replace
features.variants: Preview matches, replace one or all, and retain recovery

features.name: Go To
features.variants: Navigate directly to addresses or named ranges

features.name: Go To Special
features.variants: Select formulas, constants, blanks, comments, regions, arrays, objects or row/column differences

features.name: Object selection
features.variants: Select and inspect drawing/chart objects independently of cells

groups.acceptance: A find result returns stable sheet identity and cell/object location. Replace reports affected cells before a bulk write. Search in formulas and displayed values are distinct modes.

features.name: Pivot tables
features.variants: Source data, field placement, aggregation, grouping, filters and refresh

features.name: Pivot charts
features.variants: Chart a pivot result with the related field/filter state

features.name: Charts
features.variants: Column/bar, line/area, pie/doughnut, scatter/bubble, statistical, hierarchy, waterfall and combo families

features.name: Chart editing
features.variants: Series, axes, titles, legends, labels, units and data-source changes

features.name: Sparklines
features.variants: Compact line, column and win/loss visualizations

features.name: Slicers and timelines
features.variants: Interactive filtering controls linked to supported data objects

groups.acceptance: Objects reference structured source data; their calculations and chart series are readable without screenshots. Stale pivots are marked until refreshed. Offline maps must declare their local data requirements.

features.name: Images
features.variants: Embed, crop, resize, position and supply alternative text

features.name: Shapes and diagrams
features.variants: Shapes, connectors, icons and grouped objects

features.name: Rich visual assets
features.variants: Diagram templates, screenshots and supported 3D assets

features.name: Text elements
features.variants: Text boxes, decorative text and symbols/equations

features.name: Links and embedded objects
features.variants: Explicit destinations, local references and supported attachments

features.name: Object layout
features.variants: Select, reorder layers, align, distribute, group and lock

groups.acceptance: Every object has a stable ID, geometry, reading order and semantic content. Local assets remain available offline; unsupported external or embedded content is identified rather than executed implicitly.

features.name: Pen tools
features.variants: Pen/highlighter, color and thickness

features.name: Ink editing
features.variants: Erase, select and move ink strokes

features.name: Ink interpretation
features.variants: Optional shape/math conversion and replay where available

groups.acceptance: Store editable strokes and accessible descriptions; optional recognition must declare model availability and its confidence. Do not claim a cloud recognition service works offline.

features.name: Themes
features.variants: Coordinated colors, fonts and effects

features.name: Paper setup
features.variants: Margins, orientation, paper size and page order

features.name: Print scope
features.variants: Print area, selected ranges and repeated title rows/columns

features.name: Pagination
features.variants: Page breaks and fit-to-page scaling

features.name: Page content
features.variants: Headers, footers, page numbers and background behavior

features.name: Print visibility
features.variants: Gridlines, row/column headings and hidden content policy

features.name: Output
features.variants: Preview, printer selection and local PDF generation

groups.acceptance: Preview and exported/printed pages use the same layout calculation. A ten-page sheet cannot silently lose its final rows. Agents can request pagination metadata and a PDF without opening a printer dialog.

features.name: Operators and precedence
features.variants: Arithmetic, comparison, concatenation and reference operators

features.name: Reference types
features.variants: Relative, absolute, mixed, cross-sheet and structured references

features.name: Defined names
features.variants: Workbook/sheet scope, creation, inspection, rename and deletion

features.name: Array behavior
features.variants: Array formulas, dynamic spills and explicit spill conflicts

features.name: Recalculation
features.variants: Automatic/manual mode, dirty dependencies and targeted/full recalculation

features.name: Errors and cycles
features.variants: Typed errors, traceable causes and defined circular-reference behavior

features.name: Dates, locale and precision
features.variants: Date systems, numeric limits and locale-aware input/output

features.name: Function availability
features.variants: Versioned function catalog with explicit support status for each function

groups.acceptance: Function existence is not proof of compatibility. Test coercion, blanks, errors, arrays and edge cases per function. Unsupported functions return a precise diagnostic without rewriting the workbook.

features.name: Arithmetic and aggregation
features.variants: SUM/SUMIFS, PRODUCT, rounding, conditional counts and sums

features.name: Logical and errors
features.variants: IF/IFS, AND/OR/NOT, SWITCH, IFERROR/IFNA

features.name: Lookup and reference
features.variants: Lookup families, INDEX/MATCH and reference construction

features.name: Text
features.variants: Parsing, joining, searching, replacement, case and character handling

features.name: Date and time
features.variants: Calendar arithmetic, business-day and elapsed-time calculations

features.name: Financial
features.variants: Cashflow, interest, depreciation and valuation functions

features.name: Statistics
features.variants: Distributions, descriptive statistics, regression and testing

features.name: Specialized families
features.variants: Engineering, complex numbers, database criteria, information and compatibility functions

features.name: Modern formula composition
features.variants: Dynamic-array transformation, LET/LAMBDA and helper functions where supported

features.name: External function classes
features.variants: Cube, web, real-time and extension functions require explicit integrations

groups.acceptance: Use the official alphabetical catalog as the versioned index. Maintain one support/test row per function and variant in implementation work; this feature-family list is not a claim that every function is implemented.

features.name: Function help
features.variants: Search functions, inspect signatures and enter arguments

features.name: Reference picking
features.variants: Select referenced cells/ranges while editing a formula

features.name: Formula display
features.variants: Toggle formulas versus calculated results

features.name: Dependency inspection
features.variants: Trace precedents/dependents and navigate errors

features.name: Evaluation tools
features.variants: Inspect intermediate evaluation and watch selected values

groups.acceptance: Return an agent-readable dependency graph and evaluation explanation. UI tracing uses the same engine data; stale cached values are labeled.

features.name: Local import
features.variants: Text/CSV, workbook and structured local-file sources

features.name: Import controls
features.variants: Encoding, delimiters, headers and column data types

features.name: Query definitions
features.variants: Reusable transformation steps and inspectable dependencies

features.name: Table transformations
features.variants: Select/filter, change types, split, merge, join, append, group and pivot/unpivot

features.name: Connections and refresh
features.variants: List, refresh, cancel and inspect source status

features.name: External sources
features.variants: Web/database connectors are optional, separately configured integrations

groups.acceptance: Preview inferred types before committing. A refresh is transactional. Offline operation succeeds for available local sources and reports unavailable external sources without freezing the app.

features.name: Text to columns
features.variants: Delimiter/fixed-width splitting with destination preview

features.name: Duplicate handling
features.variants: Identify and remove duplicates by explicit keys

features.name: Validation
features.variants: Type/range/list/custom rules with input messages and error behavior

features.name: Data consolidation
features.variants: Combine compatible ranges using explicit keys/aggregations

features.name: Relational model
features.variants: Relationships, keys, measures and supported model refresh

features.name: Data cleanup
features.variants: Trim/normalize/convert with an affected-value preview

groups.acceptance: Agents cannot bypass validation that constrains human writes. A duplicate-removal receipt records the chosen keys and removed rows. Preserve numeric-looking identifiers during import and cleanup.

features.name: What-if analysis
features.variants: Goal seek, scenarios and one-/two-input data tables

features.name: Forecasting
features.variants: Forecast series with visible assumptions and uncertainty

features.name: Optimization
features.variants: Solver-style objectives, constraints and local solver capabilities

features.name: Outline
features.variants: Group/ungroup rows or columns and show/hide detail

features.name: Subtotals
features.variants: Grouped aggregation with clear behavior under filtering

groups.acceptance: Analysis reports assumptions, convergence and errors. A forecast is labeled as a model output. Scenario changes have deterministic restoration and an agent-readable result.

features.name: Language tools
features.variants: Spelling, thesaurus and optional translation

features.name: Comments and notes
features.variants: Create, inspect, navigate, resolve and distinguish threaded discussion from notes

features.name: Accessibility
features.variants: Inspect names, contrast, reading order and object alternatives

features.name: Workbook protection
features.variants: Sheet restrictions, workbook structure and file-level protection are separate

features.name: Review history
features.variants: Inspect supported change history and compare versions

groups.acceptance: Local review works without an account. Translation/cloud comments are optional integrations. Protection capabilities and cryptographic limits must be described precisely.

features.name: View modes
features.variants: Normal, page layout and page-break preview

features.name: Visibility
features.variants: Gridlines, headings, formula bar and other workspace elements

features.name: Zoom
features.variants: Continuous zoom, presets and selection-based zoom

features.name: Freeze and split
features.variants: Freeze configured rows/columns, split panes and unfreeze

features.name: Multiple windows
features.variants: Arrange, compare side by side and supported synchronized navigation

features.name: Saved views
features.variants: Persist useful filters, layout and view configuration

features.name: Status summaries
features.variants: Count, numeric count, sum, average, minimum and maximum for a selection

groups.acceptance: View changes do not modify cell values. Expose visible bounds, filters and frozen ranges to agents so human context can be understood without taking a screenshot.

features.name: File lifecycle
features.variants: New, templates, open, recent, save, save-as and close

features.name: Formats
features.variants: XLSX and supported CSV/text/ODS/PDF/legacy or macro formats with explicit fidelity levels

features.name: Metadata
features.variants: Properties, authoring metadata and document inspection

features.name: Recovery
features.variants: Autosave, version history, crash recovery and conflict handling

features.name: Options
features.variants: Locale, defaults, calculation settings and accessibility preferences

features.name: Sharing/export
features.variants: Local copies and optional configured collaboration providers

groups.acceptance: Round-trip fixtures cover data, formulas, types, formats, objects and metadata independently. Unsupported content yields a loss report. Recovery restores a complete consistent document rather than only visible values.

features.name: Local agent API
features.variants: Schema discovery, commands, event subscriptions and structured results

features.name: Macros/scripts
features.variants: Record or execute supported automation in a bounded local environment

features.name: Custom functions
features.variants: Register names, signatures, permissions and calculation behavior

features.name: Extension management
features.variants: Inspect, enable, disable, update and remove extensions

features.name: Developer workflows
features.variants: Debugging, script logs, diagnostics and reproducible automation

features.name: Optional services
features.variants: Cloud AI, online sharing and remote connectors are separate from the offline core

groups.acceptance: Never interpret imported macros as authorization to run code. Extension installation and execution declare permissions. The offline core must remain usable with every optional service disconnected.
